metadata.note: The three things `sync` could not read back: an sshd_config.d drop-in, /etc/samba/smb.conf, and a firewalld zone other than `public`. All three were one-way streets — apply wrote them, plan showed them, sync did not see them — so capturing a machine and re-applying the capture dropped an SSH hardening file, every Samba share, and the whole `home` zone. For the QEMU VM harness (scripts/vmtest/qemu.sh install-driven, then drive guest-sync-etc-zones.sh ETCZONES-DONE). Targets the guest's /dev/vda. NOT for real hardware. Autologins root on ttyS0 and ships python-pydantic/python-colorama via pacman, so the driver gets a shell and dasik runs from the 9p-mounted repo with no network.
metadata.note_samba: The samba PACKAGE is deliberately not installed: smb.conf is discovered as an admin-written file, and a machine that never installed samba is the case where a captured smb.conf must NOT come back as something a package owns.

rich_rules: rule service name="ssh" accept limit value="2/m"
